visible_observation: The artist's name ('ELARA VANCE') is rendered in a low-contrast yellow, overlaid directly onto the first line of the exhibition title ('ECHOES'). The text is extremely small and lacks a background mask or sufficient color separation from the white title text.
critique: This creates a critical failure in the visual hierarchy and legibility. The artist's name is effectively invisible against the white text, violating the mandate that the artist must be identifiable within seconds. It also introduces visual 'noise' that disrupts the clean, atmospheric typography of the main title.
revision: Move the artist's name to a distinct line above the title with increased font size and weight, or place it below the title with a solid background block to ensure separation. Ensure the color contrast ratio is high enough to be read instantly.
protected_strength: The strong, high-contrast serif typography of the main title and the atmospheric, geometric composition of the artwork area.
